sections.content: After a number or a quantity word like egy (one) or sok (many), Hungarian nouns stay in the singular — no plural -k.
sections.title: Counting without plurals

items.english: There are many family members in the photo.
There are many books in the room.

sections.content: This trips up English speakers constantly — 'many books' needs a plural in English, but sok könyv stays singular in Hungarian, just like két könyv (two books).
